full_judgment: 2. Plaintiff-respondent No. 1 filed the aforesaid suit on the allegations inter alia that he became 16 annas owner of the suit property which as a two-storied old building at 134, Shakhari Bazar, PS Kotwali, Dhaka by purchase from Nandi brothers who were the original owners by auction purchase and otherwise. The plaintiff's name was mutated in the SA Khatian and in the records of the Municipal Corporation and he is paying rents and taxes for more than 12 years. He inducted monthly tenant in the suit premises since July, 1972 but the monthly tenant without the knowledge and authority of the plaintiff sub-let the first floor of the building in 1978 to the petitioner who is defendant No. 4 in the suit. For non-payment of rent and induction of a sub-tenant without authority the plaintiff filed a suit for ejectment impleading both the tenant and the petitioner (sub-tenant) and when the suit was ripe for final disposal the petitioner in collusion with defendant No. 3, Assistant Custodian of Vested Property, Dhaka caused enlistment of the suit property as an enemy property. In Title Suit No. 34, of 1992 the plaintiff prayed for declaration of title, declaration that the connected VP proceeding is illegal, etc. and for permanent injunction restraining the defendants from interfering with the possession of the plaintiff and his tenants in the suit property.
